education is a separate j2 arm tightly coupled to orientation. its primary mission is enterprise-wide education, while it also serves as the professional schoolhouse for j2 itself. education is both an institution and a physical place: a serious learning campus and conference center with classrooms, residential capacity, case rooms, mock executive and board environments, and space for convening across sable harbor.

education owns teaching practice: deep corporate and role education, business-line literacy, learning paths, cases, lessons learned, mandatory compliance education, executive formation, j2 professional formation, exercises, and the conversion of important learning into usable instruction.

legal, safety, hr, and compliance may own requirements, subject matter, and required legal content. j2 education owns pedagogy, instructional/delivery design, relevance, engagement, and connection to real work. sexual-harassment, workplace-violence, safety, compliance, assurance, and technical education receive the same standard of excellence; mandatory never means intentionally lifeless.

## four missions

1. **enterprise education.** make sable harbor legible to its people and raise institutional literacy across business lines and headquarters.
2. **executive formation.** give newly appointed senior executives, business heads, corporate officers, and selected headquarters leaders a common grounding in sable harbor's institutions, decision system, history, responsibilities, and realities.
3. **j2 professional formation.** train and continuously develop contact, judgment, orientation, jag, and education professionals, including specialist schools, exercises, apprenticeships, and continuing professional education.
4. **convening.** operate a serious enterprise conference center where difficult problems, cross-business learning, after-action work, research, and professional communities can meet away from normal headquarters rhythms.

## educational constitution

education makes sable harbor legible to its people. institutional literacy includes why the company exists, how its business lines actually operate, where authority sits, how evidence becomes judgment, how physical reality constrains models, and how lessons change institutional behavior. deep learning and mandatory learning belong to one profession because both require respect for the learner and fidelity to reality.

education converts doctrine and operational learning into instruction without claiming ownership of the underlying law, safety rule, control, technical truth, or business decision. subject-matter owners approve required content. education challenges incoherent, irrelevant, or pedagogically ineffective material and designs delivery, practice, assessment, reinforcement, and refresh.

## program families

education maintains five standing program families:

- **sable harbor formation:** institutional literacy for headquarters staff, selected business leaders, and other roles whose work requires understanding the enterprise beyond a single function.
- **executive formation:** a residential, case-based program for newly appointed senior leaders. a one-week course is the default design point, with extensions where role complexity warrants.
- **j2 professional education:** entry formation and continuing education for contact, judgment, orientation, jag, and education staff.
- **enterprise professional programs:** advanced courses in reasoning, evidence, decision quality, postmortems, business-line literacy, technical subjects, and other capabilities that materially improve institutional performance.
- **convenings and exercises:** conferences, simulations, cross-business problem sessions, case immersions, and controlled decision exercises.

residential attendance is not universal. it is expected for j2 entrants, new corporate officers, business heads, and selected headquarters roles where the value of immersion justifies removal from ordinary work.

## learning products

the arm maintains role pathways, business-line literacy, technical deep dives, cases, field-derived lessons, leadership learning, and mandatory curricula. a case preserves uncertainty and decision context rather than flattening history into a moral with an obvious answer. when lawful, learners encounter the evidence, assumptions, dissent, and consequences that made the situation real.

blackridge is part of the institutional case canon and may be used both openly and in disguised form where preserving uncertainty improves learning. education may also build high-fidelity simulated boardrooms, executive offices, operations rooms, interview rooms, and crisis environments for professional formation and orientation assessment and selection.

learning effectiveness is not completion alone. evidence may include recall, application, changed field behavior, reduced repeated error, better escalation, improved question quality, and learner feedback. education does not manipulate these into vanity metrics.

## staffing and faculty model

the permanent education establishment is approximately **35 billets**. the permanent core includes the head of education, deputy leadership, senior faculty, instructors, exercise and case designers, program/registrar staff, learning operations, and campus/program support.

the permanent core is intentionally supplemented by rotating practitioners from contact, judgment, orientation, jag, headquarters functions, and operating businesses. education does not build a giant detached faculty when current practitioners can teach from real work. rotating faculty remain subject-matter contributors; education retains ownership of pedagogy and instructional quality.

the campus itself may support substantially more people than the permanent thirty-five-person establishment because facilities, hospitality, events, and shared enterprise services can scale independently of the teaching corps.

## relationship to orientation and jag

orientation identifies changes in institutional understanding that require education. jag returns field context, reusable practices, failed interventions, and teaching material through human handoff. education may support the final stewardship phase of a jag tour and may send instructors into operating environments to understand the work being taught.

education owns the assessment and selection environment for orientation candidates under the standards of the orientation profession. it maintains the physical and instructional infrastructure, role-player pool, case library, safeguards, and exercise integrity while orientation owns admission standards and final commissioning decisions.

## search as institutional navigation

alexandria search is built for people who may not know the repository name, owning function, final terminology, or perfect query. a future employee searching `transportation scheduling` should be able to enter years of relevant questions, evidence, traffic, judgments, decisions, outcomes, jag observations, finance assumptions, business-line material, and learning—subject to access.

search operates across full text and structured relationships: subject, topic, business line, entity/asset where applicable, related decision, judgment problem, collection requirement, author/origin, time dimensions, current state, supersession/correction, confidence, dissent, and reference thread. results distinguish authoritative records, evidence, and daedalus synthetic material.

rabbit holes are a feature when provenance and orientation remain visible. a user can hold an item, follow references, move backward to sources, move forward to reliance/outcomes, compare periods or businesses, and return to the original question without losing the investigative trail.

## historical reconstruction

“take me to what we knew on the morning of x” reconstructs the accessible institutional state then: records available, understanding formed, current canon, live judgments and dissent, unresolved gaps, and decisions already made. it excludes later knowledge unless clearly shown as a later explanatory overlay.

a separate knowability inquiry identifies information that existed or could reasonably have been accessed at the time even if sable harbor had not found, routed, or understood it. the system never collapses actual knowledge and possible knowledge into one hindsight narrative.

## restricted results

search does not become an entitlement bypass. questions and existence notices may travel wider than evidence, but result counts, snippets, relationship graphs, comparisons, and daedalus answers must not leak protected content or enable prohibited inference. the exact retrieval engine and authorization implementation remain open; this doctrine defines acceptance behavior.

## quality

search quality is judged by relevant discovery, provenance preservation, temporal correctness, understandable status, and safe disclosure—not clicks, query volume, or the appearance of a single definitive answer.

assumption of risk doctrine docs/governance/assumption_of_risk_doctrine.md # assumption of risk doctrine

**document id:** `sh-gov-risk-doctrine-001` | **version:** 1.0.0 | **effective:** september 2, 2026 | **state:** locked
**owner:** corporate governance | **related:** rapid adjudication, reserved matters, decision quality | **cross-reference:** `control_dissent_and_rapid_adjudication.md`; `assumption_of_risk_form.md`

## function

an assumption of risk is the formal act by which a properly authorized decision-maker proceeds after a material adverse finding while preserving the finding, evidence, ownership, and consequences. it is neither a waiver of law or control nor a ritual signature that transfers blame.

the instrument exists because a control function's serious dissent must receive institutional attention without automatically becoming a veto. it makes the actual decision legible: who accepted which exposure, under what authority, based on what evidence and assumptions, with what mitigations and stop conditions.

## preconditions

the relevant rapid-adjudication process has identified the specific action, material finding, accountable authority, immediate safeguards, and evidence reasonably needed for decision. a protected catastrophic-safety/operating or unlawful-conduct dispute remains paused until initial adjudication. the underlying action must be within the accepting office's lawful and delegated authority.

no person may assume exposure owned by another accountable party, expand the authority of office through the form, excuse unlawful conduct, or convert unknown/unbounded exposure into an accepted risk through labels alone. where consequence belongs at a board-reserved or transformational band, only that authority can act.

## required institutional statement

the record identifies the decision and precise action; adverse finding and dissent; known evidence and provenance; important assumptions and unknowns; foreseeable consequences, including tail risks; mitigations, limits, stop conditions, and monitoring; authority relied upon; strategic-authorization owner; execution-quality owner; review/reopen triggers; effective time; and human attestation.

the statement is specific enough for a future reader to understand the ex-ante judgment. references may protect restricted evidence but may not make the rationale disappear.

## board and management ownership

when the board overrules management, the board owns strategic authorization risk and management owns execution quality. if daniel or another executive formally dissents, that dissent remains in the institutional record. good-faith execution does not become retroactive endorsement, and dissent does not authorize sandbagging.

if new material information arises, the decision may reopen. reopening changes the current decision state; it does not rewrite the original knowledge, assumptions, or ownership.

## learning and review

risk assumptions are reviewed at their stated triggers and after material outcomes. aar practice evaluates the quality of the original reasoning separately from the outcome and asks whether an envelope, model, control, question, or canon state should change. repeated assumptions around the same boundary may indicate a defective control, unrealistic envelope, capability gap, or normalization of deviance and require systemic review.

the controlled form is `sh-gov-risk-001` in `assumption_of_risk_form.md`.

**document id:** `sh-j2-collect-001` | **version:** 1.1.0 | **effective:** september 3, 2026 | **state:** locked
**owner:** contact | **related:** judgment, judgment watch, jag, orientation priorities | **cross-reference:** `contact.md`; `judgment_officer_profession.md`; `j2_headquarters.md`

## purpose

contact exists to reduce the distance between reality and sable harbor's awareness of reality. it preserves direct institutional contact with machine data, documents, people, external sources, and physical operations so that management reporting layers, incentives, summaries, and internal narratives do not become substitutes for reality.

contact is a mixed human and technical collection profession. it is not an analysis pool and not an org-chart mirror. collectors go to sources, systems, people, sites, artifacts, and externally observable reality. they return sourced observations, provenance, limitations, and unresolved gaps. judgment and orientation determine meaning elsewhere.

## requirements contract

contact is not self-directing. orientation establishes broad enterprise questions and priority intelligence requirements. a judgment officer translates a problem commission into specific collection requirements and rfis. j2 hq arbitrates conflicts and scarce capacity. contact determines lawful source, collection method, timing, provenance, and handoff.

a requirement states the question, discriminating evidence sought, why it matters, responsible problem owner, timing, known gaps, restrictions, and completion/disposition. the requirement must not imply the desired answer. contact may challenge an infeasible or poorly discriminating requirement and return it for refinement; this is professional collection judgment, not ownership of the underlying belief.

## collector bench and cell model

contact maintains a standing professional bench rather than permanent problem silos. when a live collection requirement requires concentrated work, a collection director is designated cell lead and drafts the needed disciplines from the bench. cells are temporary, problem-centered teams. they form around a requirement, operate for as long as the requirement demands, hand off evidence, and dissolve.

collectors retain their professional discipline while working operationally for the cell lead during the assignment. a cell may therefore combine human collection, systems/data work, field-technical observation, and external-source collection in one team rather than routing a problem through separate bureaucratic departments.

bench time is intentional professional time, not idle capacity. collectors use it for advanced training, source and relationship development, domain study, access-path validation, methods work, field familiarization, controlled rotations, and standing low-intensity coverage. the model is deliberately analogous to a high-end consulting bench: sable harbor carries excess professional depth so that the right team can be assembled rapidly without hollowing out standing capability.

## establishment

the working contact establishment is approximately **78 billets**:

- head of contact — 1
- deputy head of contact — 1
- collection directors — 6
- collection managers — 8
- human contact officers — 20
- digital/data collectors — 16
- field and technical collectors — 14
- external-source collectors — 10
- collection methods officers — 2

collection directors are senior problem owners for active collection cells rather than chiefs of permanent empires. collection managers maintain requirements, deconfliction, tasking state, outstanding gaps, and handoff discipline. senior individual-contributor careers remain available so excellence does not require people management.

the operating model assumes several concurrent cells of different sizes and preserves a meaningful bench rather than seeking full utilization. roughly sixty to seventy percent deployed utilization is a planning norm, not a productivity target. j2 does not reward contact for keeping everyone continuously billable.

## collection disciplines and methods

**systems and digital collection** retrieves from databases, logs, operational platforms, finance systems, foundry, alexandria interfaces, and other authorized internal systems through queries, extracts, standing pulls, time-bounded captures, and preservation. retrieval does not become institutional judgment.

**human collection** uses structured elicitation, interviews, relationship networks, direct contact, and directed asks. collectors may tell employees what observations matter during a defined period, which facts to capture, and how to report them. employees can become distributed sensors without becoming covert surveillance subjects.

**field and technical collection** directly observes physical work, assets, engineering conditions, operating environments, equipment, facilities, and processes. it can walk a plant floor, inspect an operating condition, accompany field work, verify what a system or asset actually does, and reconcile physical reality against system representations.

**jag collection** tasks field teams for observation, artifacts, interviews, operating context, and ground truth. jag reports what it saw and the limits of observation; it does not issue institutional conclusions.

**external collection** is requirement-driven lawful research across public, regulatory, commercial, market, expert, supplier, customer, competitor, community, and other authorized sources. contact does not substitute generic news aggregation for a collection plan.

**exploitation** recognizes an information-rich event—lost bid, incident, unusual maintenance, successful intervention, capital decision, outage, customer failure—as a fleeting collection opportunity. contact acts while evidence, memory, and artifacts remain fresh and respects legal, safety, privilege, and preservation constraints.

**directed observation and evidence creation** applies when discriminating evidence does not exist. contact can help design a controlled test, new measurement, structured observation, targeted data capture, or structured interview program. the record distinguishes observed evidence from designed conditions and preserves method and limitations.

## collection board

the active register shows requirements, assigned method/source, cell or collector, clock, current status, outstanding gaps, restrictions, provenance state, and evidentiary handoff. flash/current/active/standing tempo language remains provisional and may not be presented as final policy.

metrics emphasize important gaps closed, relevance, timeliness, provenance quality, and discriminating value. report count, event volume, utilization, and data accumulation are not success measures. universal surveillance, fishing expeditions, and raw-event hoarding violate doctrine.

## handoff

evidence is handed to the owning jo with source identity or protected-source handling, event/record/access time, method, chain of custody where applicable, known limitations, and unanswered gaps. contact preserves the raw signal; it does not smooth ambiguity into a convenient summary.
